tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a literature class.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: Techniques used in Latin American realist fiction
options.B: A literary genre that blends fantastical elements with the real world
options.C: The influence of Gabriel García Márquez on other authors
options.D: The use of magical elements to comment on social issues in art

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention the authors Salman Rushdie and Milan Kundera?

options.A: To explain the origin of the term "magical realism"
options.B: To show that magical realism is not only a Latin American genre
options.C: To give examples of magical realist authors whose work is more realist than magical
options.D: To support the claim that magical realist authors must bring an open mind to their work

questions.stem: What distinguishes the fantastical elements in magical realism from those in a purely fantastical work?

options.A: In magical realism, they are described at length in great detail.
options.B: In magical realism, they have serious social or political consequences.
options.C: In magical realism, they are merely the product of a character’s imagination.
options.D: In magical realism, they are never explained or even questioned.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker discuss the novel One Hundred Years of Solitude?

options.A: To provide an example of magical realism used for social and political critique
options.B: To show that the most successful magical realist works are by Latin American authors
options.C: To argue that the most interesting magical realist works contain no fantastical elements
options.D: To show that some magical realist works closely follow traditional narrative techniques

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention the moment of birth?

options.A: To indicate when socialization begins in an individual’s life
options.B: To highlight the biological development of a newborn
options.C: To explore the relationship between genetics and social behavior
options.D: To emphasize the emotional bond between caregivers and newborns

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is often considered to be the primary agent of socialization?

options.C: Peer groups

options.B: learn social norms through structured play
